facts.text: SustainDC subclasses gymnasium.Env
SustainDC is constructed from an EnvConfig mapping, not through a gymnasium.make registration
The default EnvConfig runs three agents: agent_ls, agent_dc and agent_bat
SustainDC builds the load-shifting, data-center and battery environments with make_ls_env, make_dc_pyeplus_env and make_bat_fwd_env
The load-shifting action space is Discrete(3): 0 defers all shiftable tasks, 1 does nothing and 2 processes all deferred tasks
The data-center action space is Discrete(3): a -1, 0 or +1 delta to the cooling setpoint
The battery action space is Discrete(3): 0 charge, 1 discharge and 2 idle
The load-shifting observation is a Box of 26 elements from -2 to 2
The data-center observation is a Box of 14 elements from -1 to 1
The battery observation is a Box of 13 elements from -1 to 1
reset returns one state per configured agent in a dict
step takes an action dict and returns observation, reward, terminated and truncated dicts plus an info dict
_perform_actions reads the agent_ls, agent_dc and agent_bat keys of the action dict
seed() seeds numpy, Python's random generator and torch
The simulation advances in quarter-hour steps: four timesteps per hour
At the end of an episode every agent is marked truncated and terminated stays false
The three individual rewards are produced by the ls, dc and bat reward methods
The README describes SustainDC as a set of environments for benchmarking multi-agent reinforcement learning in data centers
The README says the environments are wrapped in the Gymnasium Env class
The README says three interconnected environments simulate data-center operations

determinism.notes: reset(seed) fixes the fake's initial agent states and its transitions are deterministic, so one seed and action sequence repeat a trajectory; upstream reset() takes no seed and seeds numpy, Python and torch through seed(), so a seed does not reproduce an upstream trajectory

gaps: analytic F0 model: the workload, carbon-intensity, weather and battery transitions are placeholder agent-state updates, not the upstream managers or the data-center thermal, energy and battery models

the bridge serves cap.world.step.v1 as one scalar reward (the sum of three placeholder individual rewards) and one terminated/truncated flag, while upstream SustainDC returns per-agent reward, termination and truncation dicts

the fake accepts reset(seed, options) and returns a Gymnasium (observation, info) pair; upstream reset() takes no arguments and returns only the per-agent state dict, and upstream step() expects a dict keyed by agent
the fake was never compared with the upstream environment: upstream needs gymnasium, numpy, pandas, torch and the workload, weather and carbon-intensity data files, which were not installed or run
the fake models no data-center physics and offers no rendering, dashboard, snapshot or restore
wall-clock time is not paced: realtime_factor 0 and simulated time advances 15 minutes per tick only

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
